scans.target: known rejected jsPDF cdnjs/PDFObject executable loader
scans.detector: scripts/detect-remote-script-loader.mjs: containsScriptSrcLoader; matches an assigned variable receiving createElement('script'), then requires that same variable's .src assignment and appendChild within the next 2000 source characters. Handles minified identifier characters including $.

For each emitted JS/MJS file, flagged only when all three heuristics were present: a gist.github.com URL, a srcDoc/srcdoc assignment, and either a literal script tag with src or createElement('script') followed within 500 characters by .src assignment.

limitations: This is a GitHub CI development artifact, not a Store ZIP; it does not approve a Store release.
No Chrome UI or runtime behavior was checked.
The Gist scan is a heuristic over emitted strings and can miss obfuscated, computed, or structurally different loaders.
next_action: Scan the exact candidate Store ZIP with the Store release gate before any Store approval or submission.
